نستعدي (form X)
# نَسْتَعْدِي (nastaʕdī) /nas.taʕ.diː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْدَى (istaʕdā)
# نَسْتَعْدِيَ (nastaʕdiya) /nas.taʕ.di.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَعْدَى (istaʕdā)
